title: Luxembourg – Technical assistance services – Preparatory studies for vaccines production capacity increase project in Egypt
description: European Investment Bank. The EIB project aims to establish a multi-product vaccine manufacturing facility at the VACSERA site in Sixth of October City, Egypt. Its goal is to strengthen national vaccine production, support the long-term sustainability of immunisation programmes, and enhance regional health security through the supply of high-quality, WHO-prequalified vaccines, in line with Egypt’s Vision 2030 and broader African self-sufficiency objectives. The present Technical Assistance (TA) assignment will support VACSERA by conducting a comprehensive feasibility study and market analysis. The consultant will provide evidence-based recommendations on the project design, vaccine production priorities, facility production capacity requirements, and implementation strategy

title: Consultancy Services to Support Africa CDC and the African Union in Assessing the Feasibility of the Implementation of a Continental Health Financing Observatory for AU Member States
description: The Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention (Africa CDC) invites eligible and qualified bilingual English/French consultancy firms to submit proposals for the Feasibility Assessment of the Establishment and Implementation of a Continental Health Financing Observatory for African Union Member States. The consultancy will undertake a comprehensive feasibility assessment for the proposed Sustainable African Centre for Investment in Health Accountability (SACIA) Observatory, including the development of an institutional model, governance framework, financial sustainability pathway, and phased implementation roadmap to strengthen health financing intelligence, foster fiscal dialogue and evidence-informed decision-making and policy reforms across AU Member States. Duration : Three (3) months with the possibility of extension based on project needs. Location : Remote, with in-country missions in two (2) AU Member States. Interested firms are requested to submit their proposals in accordance with the requirements and instructions set out in the Solicitation Document. Interested firms must be legally registered, bilingual (English/French) consultancy firm or consortium with demonstrated expertise in health financing, public financial management (PFM), governance, institutional analysis, and multidisciplinary project management.
